## About Us
ElectroMart BD is Bangladesh's premier online electronics shop, catering to students, engineers, robotics enthusiasts, and IoT developers. We supply authentic Arduino development boards, ESP32 modules, Raspberry Pi accessories, sensors (like DHT11, HC-SR04, MQ series), motor drivers, and essential electronic components (resistors, capacitors, breadboards) nationwide across Bangladesh.

## Core Services & Policies
- **Location:** Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- **Delivery:** Fast nationwide delivery across Bangladesh.
- **Contact/Ordering:** Orders can be placed directly via WhatsApp at **+8801577098376**.
- **Pricing:** We offer the most competitive Arduino and sensor prices in Bangladesh.
- **Support:** We offer free robotics project consultation and parts lists for students.

## Popular Categories
- **Arduino & Development Boards:** Arduino Uno R3, Arduino Nano, Arduino Mega, ESP32, NodeMCU ESP8266.
- **Sensors:** Ultrasonic sensors, Temperature & Humidity (DHT11), Gas sensors, IR sensors, Accelerometers/Gyroscopes (MPU6050).
- **Robotics Parts:** Gear motors (N20), motor drivers (L298N, TB6612FNG), Servo motors (SG90).
- **Basic Components:** Breadboards, Jumper wires, Resistor packs, Capacitor kits.
